text: On one Buenos Aires street, Clara hears voices in her kitchen sink plotting to kill her, and her husband Juan finds her body [slammed against the bathroom wall by an invisible force|threat|something unseen]. Next door, Walter films [a tall naked figure rising from beneath his bed|images|pictures, screens and recordings], and Alicia's young son, killed by a bus, [returns to sit at the kitchen table|rules|the dead do not rest]. Paranormal investigators come to believe the street is [a gateway for dark entities that travel through tap water|origin|from another world].
